AFWE ReBorn Phase 0–4 is Live

Your code. Its memory. Its rules.

AFWE keeps a living record of what your code is supposed to be — and makes sure autonomous coding agents follow the plan. Double-entry bookkeeping for codebases.

Explore Core Concepts → Quick Start (5 Min)
Quick Install & Onboard Rust 1.75+
$ cargo install afwe
$ cd my-project && afwe onboard --profile normie
$ afwe turn begin "Add guest checkout" --target src/payments/**

Memory & Rationale

"API layer must remain independent of presentation layer to enable headless worker execution."

Why AFWE Exists & The Problem Spectrum

Question / Invariant grep / Search GraphRAG / Linters AFWE (.afwe/)

What imports Payments? Flat text ✓ Graph AST ✓ (Scene Graph)
Is Payments ALLOWED to import UI? ✕ ✕ ✓ Constraint Gate
Is this odd timeout a bug or intentional? ✕ ✕ ✓ Pin (intentional)

3. Unified Architecture & Audit Receipts

Every change is a receipt. Simple, clear, and checkable.

The 5 Architectural Layers Unified Truth

Same truth. Different views. One system.
Layer 5
Receipts

What happened. Append-only log of every change, signed claims, and gate decisions.

log/ & turns/*.yaml
Layer 4
Timeline

When it happened. 4D dial scrubber across turns. Restores features via 3-way merge.

afwe timeline restore
Layer 3
Graph

How it's connected. AST scene graph, directional dependencies, and geometric constraints.

constraints.yaml
Layer 2
Blueprint

What it is. Nested parcels of subsystems and modules mapped to physical source files.

blueprint.yaml
Layer 1
Features

Your product. User-facing capabilities, intents, and business deliverables.

intents/*.yaml
